note: Grassland and woods around a 96-acre lake west of Rich Hill, managed together with the adjoining Peabody Conservation Area. MDC marks two primitive camping spots together on gravel SW 9508 north of the lake: one beside a small gravel parking lot and a mowed clearing across the road. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: page 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites', Rule 140 standard; brochure 'Primitive camping is permitted only in designated areas'; map (12/9/2022) two Primitive Camping symbols at the SW 9508 lot = GIS 506 (by lot 361) and 505 (mowed clearing across the road). Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights manual. Pin nudged onto lot 361. Not waterfront kept (lake arms ~125 m+ through woods). Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Things to Do When You Visit: Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; Rule 140 standard text, no permit rule. Brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted only in designated areas.' Map (12/9/2022) legend 'Primitive Camping'; on the Harmony Mission Lake tract two symbols stacked at the Parking Lot on SW 9508 (= GIS 506, on the shoulder by lot 361, and GIS 505, ~60 m S across the road). Imagery: lot 361 is a gravel pad ~25 x 15 m on the north side of gravel SW 9508; 505 is a mowed clearing ~25 m across on the south side reached by a short grass pull-in. Designated points at a lot - stay. No horse camp, ford or rig wording; the roads in are county gravel (page: Route PP 'turns into gravel as Bates County Road 10508').
PIN: stored 38.08525,-94.42951 = GIS 506, on the road shoulder ~40 m E of the lot under a tree line. Nudge onto lot 361: 38.08508,-94.42998.
WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): the two north arms of the 96-acre lake are ~125 m (W arm) and ~185 m (E arm) from the camps through brush and woods; no view.
CLUSTERS: the other camping symbols on the same map (Strip Pits 3 and 4) belong to the adjoining Peabody Conservation Area, already its own entry 13807 (2.3 km away). No split.
PHONE: area page 'For more information call (417) 853-4592' matches stored.
Season (manual, year-round) left as stored. The page lists Waterfowl Hunting / Open Hunting; no closure zone is marked at the camp.
